name: cprmv
description: Core Public Rule Management Vocabulary ReSpec specification

scripts.build: python shaclgen.py && npx respec --no-sandbox --localhost --src index.html --out ./public/$npm_package_version/index.html && sed -r -i '' 's/file...//g' ./public/$npm_package_version/index.html && java -jar plantuml.jar --format png --output-dir ../media puml/overview.puml && cp -f -R template/* public/$npm_package_version && cp -f -R media public/$npm_package_version && cd ./public/$npm_package_version && pandoc index.html -t latex -o cprmv.pdf && cd ../.. && cp -f -R public/$npm_package_version/* ../serve_api/respec/$npm_package_version && cp -f -R public/$npm_package_version/* ../serve_api/respec

author: Bas Kaptijn
